architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages map 1:1 to Stitch screens. Shared UI components extracted from common patterns. Router use React Router v6. State local unless shared. CSS modules for scoped styles. No global state manager yet (ponytail: add Redux/Zustand when >3 shared slices).

tickets.title: Onboarding steps widget page (src/pages/OnboardingStepsWidget.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_widget to React page. Extract reusable StepIndicator component. Use CSS modules for styles. Mobile-first responsive layout. Hardcode steps data (ponytail: fetch from API when backend ready).
acceptance_criteria: StepIndicator component reusable with props: { currentStep, totalSteps, labels }

tickets.title: Onboarding web view with fixed tokens page (src/pages/OnboardingWebViewFixedTokens.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_web_view_fixed_tokens to React page. Extract TokenDisplay component. Use iframe for web view (ponytail: replace with SDK when available). Hardcode token data. Add copy-to-clipboard for tokens.
acceptance_criteria: TokenDisplay component reusable with props: { token, label, copyable }
Copy-to-clipboard work. Show success toast (ponytail: use library when >3 toasts needed)
Web view iframe load placeholder content

tickets.title: Button showcase web view page (src/pages/ButtonShowcaseWebView.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_web_view_final to React page. Extract Button component with variants: primary, secondary, danger, disabled. Use CSS modules. Add hover/focus states. Hardcode button data.
acceptance_criteria: Button component support props: { variant, size, disabled, onClick }

tickets.title: Button showcase mobile page (src/pages/ButtonShowcaseMobile.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_mobile to React page. Reuse Button component from TASK-003. Mobile-specific layout. Add touch targets (48x48px min).

tickets.title: Shared UI components and design tokens (src/components/, src/styles/)
tickets.description: Extract shared design tokens (colors, spacing, typography). Create shared components: Button, StepIndicator, TokenDisplay. Use CSS variables for tokens. Document props in JSDoc.
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens match Stitch design system
Components tested in isolation (Storybook optional, ponytail: add when >5 components)

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Add navigation bar. Set up React Router v6. Routes: /onboarding-steps, /onboarding-web-view, /button-showcase-web, /button-showcase-mobile. 404 fallback. Responsive layout. Dark/light mode toggle (ponytail: implement when design ready).
acceptance_criteria: Navigation bar present on all pages
